question: Should openclaw/plugin-sdk/reply-payload publicly guarantee TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND and isToolProgressPayload for third-party producers and channels?
rationale: The bundled Codex-to-Slack path needs a legal package boundary, but exposing this exact semantic as durable third-party API requires maintainer intent that implementation review cannot infer.

options.title: Approve generic progress contract
options.body: Keep the exports, document their transient-only non-semantic scope, and add focused direct contract coverage before merge.

options.title: Use an existing reply semantic
options.body: Remove the new public symbols and express progress through a maintainer-approved existing presentation, status, or internal contract.

recommendation.title: Approve generic progress contract
recommendation.body: Keep the exports, document their transient-only non-semantic scope, and add focused direct contract coverage before merge.
